sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission investigated conduct by former Acacia prison custodial officers as part of a joint investigation with the Department of Justice.
sentences.support: The Commission is conducting an ongoing joint investigation with the Department of Justice (DoJ) into public officers engaging in serious misconduct

sentences.text: The investigation examined drug supply, bribery and the risks of prisoners and organised crime groups corrupting staff.
sentences.support: this report highlights how prisoners and organised crime syndicates can exploit an officer's weaknesses in order to corrupt them.

sentences.text: The Commission formed serious misconduct opinions against two former custodial officers over drug activities and corruption.
sentences.section: Conclusions and opinions of serious misconduct
sentences.support: The Commission forms an opinion of serious misconduct against former custodial officer

sentences.text: Its five recommendations addressed prison entry screening, steroid education, drug testing, staff vulnerabilities and the analysis of security reports.
sentences.support: Periodic professional review of frontline prison staff be provided to identify vulnerabilities with a view to providing support and managing risk.

sentences.text: The Commission planned to report on implementation after a year.
sentences.support: The Commission proposes to report on the implementation of these recommendations in one year.

notes: No separate executive summary or overview. Existing OPAX findings are not duplicated. Serious misconduct opinions are distinguished from criminal guilt.
